Disease Subtype: IGHV-mutated, IGHV-unmutated, Trisomy 12, NOTCH1-mutant, SF3B1-mutant, CD38+
Experimental Design: Case-control, TMT batch, quantitative proteomics
Short Description: Discovery-stage study using TMT 10-plex and LC-MS to characterize isolated B-cells from CLL patients and healthy donors to identify disease-specific protein signatures
Normalization Strategy: SPIQuE (weighted PSM contributions); Regulation score (Rs); Batch effect reduction via bridging controls; platelet protein filtering
Modifications: Fixed: Methylthio (C); TMT (K, Protein N-term). Variable: TMT (Y); Oxidation (M); Deamidation (N, Q); Phosphorylation (S, T, Y)
Main_Finding: Identified a 544-protein CLL signature and independent spliceosome dysregulation as a therapeutic target

Title: Nicotine-induced protein expression profiling reveals mutually altered proteins across four human cell lines
Tissue Cell Type Detailed: Embryonic kidney (HEK293); Cervical adenocarcinoma (HeLa); Pancreatic stellate cells (RLT-PSC); Bone marrow-derived neuroblastoma (SH-SY5Y)
Experimental Design: Drug-treatment (Nicotine), TMT 10-plex, SPS-MS3, Multi-cell line comparison Mock-treatment (sterile water); Orbitrap Fusion
Short Description: The study quantified 8590 proteins across four human cell lines (HEK, HeLa, PaSC, SH-SY5Y), each mock- or nicotine-treated, using TMT 10-plex and SPS-MS3 to profile nicotine-induced proteomic alterations.
Normalization Strategy: Summed reporter ion intensity normalization per channel
Modifications: Fixed: Carbamidomethyl (C); TMT 10-plex (K, Protein N-term). Variable: Oxidation (M)
Main_Finding: Nicotine increased 31 proteins (e.g., APP, APLP2, LAPTM4B, NCOA4) across all four cell lines; ~40% membrane/signaling; autophagy-related pathways

Quantification_Format: Normalized summed TMT reporter ion S/N per channel (126-131); protein abundance = sum of reporter counts across PSMs; log2(nicotine/null) per cell line from summed S/N (MS3; Sequest + LDA; 1% protein FDR)

Title: Isoelectric point-based fractionation by HiRIEF coupled to LC-MS allows for in-depth quantitative analysis of the phosphoproteome

Short Description: Non-phospho HiRIEF LC-MS/MS TMT 10-plex dataset on asynchronous untreated HeLa cervix adenocarcinoma cells; from full 10-plex design only 4 untreated channels retained for atlas

Title: Discovery of coding regions in the human genome by integrated proteogenomics analysis workflow

Title: Tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase (TRAP/ACP5) promotes metastasis-related properties via TGFβ2/TβR and CD44 in MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells
Tissue Cell Type Detailed: MDA-MB-231 invasive breast cancer cell line; harvested at equal confluence

Title: Multiomic analysis of homologous recombination-deficient end-stage high-grade serous ovarian cancer
Tissue Cell Type Detailed: Detailed Laser microdissection-enriched tumor epithelium and tumor-associated stroma
Experimental Design: Multi-region homologous recombination-deficient end-stage high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort; laser microdissection-enriched tumor epithelium and tumor-associated stroma; seven tumor tandem mass tag pro sixteen-plex experiments and seven stroma tandem mass tag pro sixteen-plex experiments
Short Description: Tandem mass tag pro sixteen-plex liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry proteomic profiling of laser microdissection-enriched tumor epithelium and tumor-associated stroma from end-stage homologous recombination-deficient high-grade serous ovarian cancer specimens
Modifications: Fixed: Carbamidomethyl (C), TMTpro (K, N-term); Variable: Oxidation (M)
Main_Finding: End-stage homologous recombination-deficient high-grade serous ovarian cancer showed extensive spatial and inter-lesion molecular heterogeneity, polyclonal disease architecture, multiple resistance mechanisms, immune escape, and increased oxidative phosphorylation pathway abundance, especially in autopsy stromal samples.
Data_Caveats: The dataset contains no healthy controls and no adjacent normal tissue. Tumor and stroma are two laser microdissection-separated compartments from cancer specimens, not cancer versus healthy groups. The value 224 represents all tandem mass tag pro channel positions across fourteen multiplexes; after excluding pooled reference channels and channels marked not applicable, 196 biological sample-channel measurements remain. Multiple samples were collected from the same 15 patients across anatomical sites and timepoints. PRIDE lists fourteen search files and no deposited merged result file; normalization and merging should be verified from processed files or previous methodology.
